prs.title: Release: March 2, 2026 - AWS Listed Competitors Fix & App Runner Update
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Combines a modest bug fix to the competitors collector/entrypoint logic with config updates (apprunner.yaml, .gitignore) and several documentation/release artifacts, amounting to a small-medium release bundle with limited novel complexity.

stories.name: AWS Marketplace Competitor Accuracy & Infrastructure Stability
